name: Pointillism
garments: not a fashion look — a painting technique (also called Pointillism, or Divisionism)

media.title: Georges Seurat, A Sunday on La Grande Jatte (1884–86)

reacts_against: Impressionism's intuitive, fast brushwork, replacing it with a slower, scientific method: tiny dots of pure, unmixed color placed so the eye blends them at a distance (a real optical effect, though weaker than the painters themselves sometimes claimed).

findings: mostly muted — about 55% of the measured color is low-saturation (greys, dusty tones)
measured.caveat: Colors measured from Wikimedia Commons images as photographed and displayed on screen; actual materials vary, and screen colors are approximate.
